---
title: "Prune Overlapping Intervals Transform"
---

## Overview

The `PruneOverlappingIntervals` transform applies greedy keep-first overlap pruning to a `DigitalIntervalSeries`, producing a disjoint (non-overlapping) `DigitalIntervalSeries`. This is the materialized counterpart to the overlap pruning in `PlotAlignmentGather`, applied directly to interval bounds rather than alignment-point windows.

The transform is parameterless and preserves the input `TimeFrame`.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/TransformsV2/algorithms/PruneOverlappingIntervals/PruneOverlappingIntervals.hpp` | Function declaration |
| `src/TransformsV2/algorithms/PruneOverlappingIntervals/PruneOverlappingIntervals.cpp` | Algorithm implementation |
| `src/TransformsV2/algorithms/PruneOverlappingIntervals/PruneOverlappingIntervals.test.cpp` | Unit tests |

## Parameters

```cpp
struct PruneOverlappingIntervalsParams {};
```

Currently empty; reserved for future pruning policy options (e.g. alternative overlap policies).

## Algorithm

1. Collect all intervals from the input series (sorted by start time).
2. Greedy left-to-right scan:
   - Keep the first interval.
   - For each subsequent interval, keep it only if `interval.start > last_kept.end`.
   - Touching intervals (`start == last_kept.end`) are treated as overlapping and pruned.
3. Return a new `DigitalIntervalSeries` with `IntervalLayout::Disjoint` and the input `TimeFrame`.

This matches `pruneOverlappingAlignmentTimes` in `PlotAlignmentGather.hpp` with interval bounds used directly as the pruning window.

## Registration

Registered in `RegisteredTransforms.cpp` as:

```cpp
RegisterContainerTransform<DigitalIntervalSeries, DigitalIntervalSeries, PruneOverlappingIntervalsParams>(
    "PruneOverlappingIntervals", pruneOverlappingIntervals, ...);
```

## Pipeline Usage

```json
{
  "steps": [{
    "step_id": "prune_windows",
    "transform_name": "PruneOverlappingIntervals",
    "input_key": "stimulus_windows",
    "output_key": "stimulus_windows_disjoint"
  }]
}
```

## Relationship to GatherResult Migration

This transform implements the overlap pruning step described in `digital_interval_series_migration_design.qmd`. Typical composition after event window expansion:

```text
DigitalEventSeries -> EventToInterval -> PruneOverlappingIntervals -> DigitalIntervalSeries
```

## Edge Cases

| Input | Behavior |
|-------|----------|
| Empty interval series | Returns empty disjoint `DigitalIntervalSeries` |
| Single interval | Returns that interval unchanged |
| Well-separated intervals | All intervals kept |
| Overlapping or touching intervals | Greedy keep-first pruning |
| Overlapping input layout | Output is always `Disjoint` |
| Cancellation | Returns empty disjoint series |

## Tests

Colocated tests cover empty input, single interval, well-separated intervals, overlapping/touching pruning, chain pruning, TimeFrame propagation, overlapping input layout, and registry execution.
